resources.string: %1$s: this dose was due before food; it is not marked as taken.
%1$s: a meal is logged; this dose is taken with food.
%1$s: this dose is taken with food, but no meal is logged yet.
Stopping the sound does not mark the dose as taken.

Medicine alarms ring for up to a minute. Allow exact alarms for scheduled times and full-screen access for the lock screen. Without these permissions, reminders may be delayed or shown as notifications. Food and water use ordinary notifications.
The “%1$s” channel is muted in Android settings, so doses arrive as ordinary notifications, without the ring.
Is it time to eat? Or did you eat without me?
Remember to drink fluids. Add water.
